target: acceptances 5+6 — the spec stage must run this BEFORE spending the reviewer, and must pass candidates into the reviewer payload. Checked structurally: the call must appear before the delegate step, and the payload amendment must be declared.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/spec/SKILL.md"; chk=$(grep -n "spec_check.sh" "$f" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); rev=$(grep -n "loop-reviewer" "$f" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); cand=$(grep -ci "candidate" "$f"); printf '{"checkLine":%s,"reviewerLine":%s,"mentionsCandidates":%s}' "${chk:-0}" "${rev:-0}" "$cand"
